personas.name: Investigation-oriented failure analyst
personas.summary: Loves evidence-rich root-cause work and dislikes vague coordination-heavy programs.
personas.careerText: Led cross-functional investigations into intermittent device failures using logs, bench tests, Python analysis, and teardown evidence. Built scripts that reconciled test data, found root causes, and verified fixes. Dislikes requirement traceability marathons and status-meeting-heavy projects.

personas.name: Greenfield software creator
personas.summary: Enjoys blank-sheet product software and visible user feedback.
personas.careerText: Built new SaaS features from concept to launch, loved prototyping interfaces, user testing, and rapid iteration. Less interested in hardware failures or regulated documentation.

personas.name: Open-ended research data scientist
personas.summary: Likes ambiguous research questions and model exploration.
personas.careerText: Explored uncertain data science questions, built models, published analyses, and enjoyed framing unknown problems. Finds tightly scoped sustaining work limiting.

personas.name: Experiment-loving documentation-averse engineer
personas.summary: Wants tests and measurable feedback without compliance-heavy work.
personas.careerText: Designed experiments to characterize process failures, automated data capture, and improved yield. Strongly dislikes QMS paperwork, supplier quality, and repetitive protocol execution.

personas.name: Quality engineer who dislikes compliance
personas.summary: Very hireable for quality roles but wants investigative work instead.
personas.careerText: Owned CAPA investigations, audits, and validation packages. Enjoyed the investigative parts of quality but disliked compliance administration and traceability paperwork.

personas.name: Robotics-interested candidate lacking C++
personas.summary: Strong work fit for robotics field performance, lower current hireability due to C++/ROS gaps.
personas.careerText: Built Python tools for sensor data review and loved debugging robot demos in coursework. No professional C++, ROS, embedded, or controls experience yet.

personas.name: Strong programmer who dislikes physical systems
personas.summary: High software capability, low appetite for labs, hardware, or field troubleshooting.
personas.careerText: Senior TypeScript and backend engineer who likes internal tools, APIs, and developer productivity. Avoids hardware labs, travel, and physical troubleshooting.

personas.name: Stakeholder-coordination-oriented professional
personas.summary: Enjoys orchestration, ambiguity, and customer-facing systems tradeoffs.
personas.careerText: Coordinated requirements across engineering, customers, and operations. Enjoyed ambiguity, roadmapping, and aligning teams more than deep data analysis.

personas.name: Controls-oriented engineer
personas.summary: Likes applied dynamics, characterization, and test-backed tuning.
personas.careerText: Characterized dynamic systems, tuned controllers in MATLAB/Python, and validated model behavior against test data. Likes applied math but not endless theory.

personas.name: Scientific software builder
personas.summary: Builds tools for scientific users and data-heavy workflows.
personas.careerText: Developed Python and TypeScript tools for researchers to analyze instrument outputs. Enjoyed connecting domain data, visualization, and reproducible analysis.

personas.name: Field-service troubleshooter
personas.summary: Likes customer context, fast feedback, and real systems.
personas.careerText: Solved escalated customer issues on complex lab instruments, captured logs, replaced modules, and taught customers how to recover. Enjoys field context and dislikes long internal-only projects.

personas.name: Product strategist who loves ambiguity
personas.summary: Enjoys broad product questions and cross-functional tradeoffs.
personas.careerText: Led discovery for ambiguous product areas, interviewed customers, framed strategy, and made roadmap tradeoffs. Less interested in narrow technical troubleshooting.

personas.name: Routine/process-oriented operator
personas.summary: Prefers stable procedures and clear success criteria.
personas.careerText: Executed release checklists, maintained process documentation, and enjoyed dependable routines with clear standards. Dislikes ambiguous exploratory work.

personas.name: Highly theoretical research-oriented user
personas.summary: Prefers models, literature, and long-cycle inquiry.
personas.careerText: Designed theoretical models, read literature deeply, and pursued open questions with long feedback loops. Finds applied test execution too constrained.

personas.name: Low-information / low-confidence user
personas.summary: Sparse input should produce lower confidence and broader recommendations.
personas.careerText: I have done some projects with data and tools. I like solving problems but I am not sure what kind.

functions.name: Failure Analysis / Reliability / Sustaining R&D
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Investigate why real products fail, gather evidence, test hypotheses, and close the loop with fixes.
functions.longerDescription: Evidence-rich root-cause work across logs, hardware, test data, and manufacturing or field signals.

functions.name: Sensor & Algorithm Performance
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Use data and experiments to understand where sensing or algorithm behavior succeeds and fails.
functions.longerDescription: Applied data work that ties model behavior to real-world signal quality, cohorts, instrumentation, and edge cases.

functions.name: Test Development & Performance Characterization
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Build test methods and experiments that reveal system behavior under meaningful conditions.
functions.longerDescription: A mix of experimental design, instrumentation, automation, analysis, and actionable characterization.

functions.name: Systems Integration & Real-World Debug
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Trace cross-layer failures that only appear when hardware, software, sensors, and users meet.
functions.longerDescription: Integration troubleshooting across interfaces, logs, field signals, and experiments.

functions.name: Engineering Tools / Automation / Data Integration
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Turn tedious engineering workflows into reliable tools that connect data and reduce manual reconciliation.
functions.longerDescription: Software-building with a concrete engineering or scientific workflow as the customer.

functions.name: Clinical / Real-World Algorithm Performance
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Investigate how technical systems perform across messy real-world populations and contexts.
functions.longerDescription: Applied evidence work that separates algorithm behavior, workflow effects, and data quality.

functions.name: Technical Field Service / Applications
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Solve technical issues with customers in the field and translate patterns back to product teams.
functions.longerDescription: Customer-facing troubleshooting with real systems, fast feedback, and communication demands.

functions.name: Robotics / Autonomy Field Performance
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Diagnose robot behavior in real environments and improve sensing, autonomy, and operations.
functions.longerDescription: High-fit for people who like embodied systems, logs, experiments, and cross-layer behavior.

functions.name: Controls & System Characterization
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Characterize dynamic systems and tune or validate behavior using models and experiments.
functions.longerDescription: Applied controls work anchored in measured behavior rather than pure theory.

functions.name: Scientific Software
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Build software that makes scientific or technical evidence easier to analyze, simulate, and use.
functions.longerDescription: Software creation tied to scientific workflows, models, instrumentation, or data interpretation.

functions.name: Verification / Validation / Software Test
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Confirm systems meet requirements through protocols, tests, traceability, and documented evidence.
functions.longerDescription: Important but often documentation-heavy work, distinct from exploratory failure analysis.

functions.name: Modeling / Simulation / Digital Twins
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Create and calibrate models that explain or predict technical system behavior.
functions.longerDescription: Can be high-fit for theory-friendly users, but too abstract for those needing fast real-world feedback.

functions.name: Broad Product R&D / Systems Engineering
functions.oneSentenceTaskLoop: Shape broad product direction, requirements, interfaces, and tradeoffs across teams.
functions.longerDescription: Valuable work, but often ambiguous and coordination-heavy compared with hands-on investigation.
